title: Two-stage active low-pass native acceptance
application: 0.1 V DC input; low-frequency gain 10; two buffered RC stages and 100k load; ideal model only
netlist:
V1 in 0 DC 0.1 AC 1
VCC vcc 0 DC 15
VSS vss 0 DC -15
R1 in lp1 10k
C1 lp1 0 10n
XU1 lp1 fb1 vcc vss stage1 OPAMP5
RF1 stage1 fb1 10k
RG1 fb1 0 10k
R2 stage1 lp2 10k
C2 lp2 0 10n
XU2 lp2 fb2 vcc vss out OPAMP5
RF2 out fb2 40k
RG2 fb2 0 10k
RL out 0 100k
.end
